title: Remarkably stable luminescence thermometric performance of upconverting LiYF4:Yb3+,Tm3+ nanoparticles obtained via an anhydrous precursor strategy

synthesis.procedure: Under argon (Schlenk), Gd(TFA)3(H2O)3 (1.11 g, 2.0 mmol), Li(TFA)(H2O) (0.28 g, 2.0 mmol) and N-methyldiethanolamine (mdeaH2, 0.46 mL, 4.0 mmol) were taken in THF (10 mL) and stirred at 750 rpm for 2 h. The solution was concentrated and layered with hexane. Colorless crystals suitable for single-crystal X-ray diffraction grew overnight, were isolated by decanting the solvents and washed twice with cold hexane. Yield 70% based on Gd(TFA)3(H2O)3. The yield could be improved to 85% by reacting Gd(TFA)3(H2O)3 (0.7 g, 1.27 mmol) with mdeaH2 (0.15 mL, 1.27 mmol) directly (without Li(TFA)(H2O)).

synthesis.procedure: Hot-injection under argon. [Y(TFA)3(monoglyme)] (2.11 mmol), [Yb(TFA)3(monoglyme)] (0.42 mmol) and [Tm(TFA)3(monoglyme)] (0.010 mmol) were taken in a Schlenk flask with 2 mL oleic acid and 2 mL 1-octadecene (solution A) and heated at 120 °C for 30 min under inert atmosphere. In parallel, 4 mL oleic acid and 4 mL 1-octadecene (solution B) were heated at 290 °C with stirring under argon. When solution B was stable at 290 °C, preheated solution A was injected all at once. After 1 h the mixture was cooled to room temperature under argon. Nanoparticles were precipitated with ethanol, separated by centrifugation (4500 rpm, 5 min), washed three times with ethanol and dried in air at room temperature for 24 h. Crystallite size 21.3 ± 1.7 nm (PXRD/TEM).

properties.summary: Yb3+/Tm3+-doped tetragonal LiYF4 NPs show upconversion under 972 nm excitation and luminescence thermometry with high, nearly constant relative sensitivity (>1 % K−1) and good thermal cycling stability over a wide temperature window (notably 300–500 K; UC response recorded 93–483 K).
